section.title: Three objects, three gestures.
section.description: The kit fits in one hand. Each piece has its place in the gesture, its place on the bedside table, its place in the season.

paste.name: 1 Paste
paste.short_description: Smooth cream paste. Films the nail plate without sealing it. A hazelnut-sized amount is enough.
paste.narrative: 12% beeswax melted at low temperature by the beekeeping cooperative of the Middle Atlas. Three minutes of contact, the finish is matte.

cire.name: Beeswax
cire.inci_definition: Official name for pure beeswax. Films the nail without sealing it, lets the plate breathe.

jojoba.name: Jojoba oil
jojoba.inci_definition: Liquid plant wax, close to natural sebum. Softens cuticles without leaving an oily film.

tocopherol.name: Tocopherol
tocopherol.inci_definition: Plant-derived vitamin E. Protects the formula's oils from going rancid.

powder.name: 2 Powder
powder.short_description: Fine white powder, set over the paste. Absorbs the excess, polishes the surface.
powder.usage_hint: a pinch polishes the whole hand
powder.narrative: Fine mineral powder, laid just after the paste. The talc absorbs the surplus, the silica polishes the surface. No white, no grey.

talc.name: Cosmetic talc
talc.inci_definition: Pure magnesium silicate, washed and sieved. Mattifies without cracking the nail plate.

riz.name: Rice powder
riz.inci_definition: Finely ground rice starch. Absorbs the surplus paste without drying.

silice.name: Silica
silice.inci_definition: Cosmetic form of silicate. Gives the glide and reveals the shine when buffed.

polissoir.name: Step 4 buffer — Polish & Shine
polissoir.short_description: Sky blue rectangular buffer. Three sides, three grains. Reveals the natural shine.
polissoir.narrative: Three-sided buffer, from the coarsest to the softest grain. The final side reveals the shine, with no solvent, no polish. Rinses under warm water.

preparation.rituel: Gentle cleansing, attentive reading of the plate, no aggressive solvent.

tenue.vernis: 5 to 7 days on prepared nails, frequent touch-ups.
tenue.rituel: No coloured hold: the nail stays as it is, supported day by day.

recuperation.vernis: Dehydrated nail under the coat, sometimes weakened.
recuperation.rituel: Hydrated plate, supple cuticles, polishing with Step 4 kaolin.

cout.vernis: Polish + remover + repair treatments, approx. 1,500 MAD.
cout.rituel: A 199 MAD FemiGlow pack lasts four to five months. About 500 MAD per year.

impact.rituel: Beeswax, jojoba, mineral talc, rice, kaolin. Cosmos Organic certification.

temps.rituel: Five minutes a day, a slow gesture, no forced drying.

comparatif.title: Classic polish and the FemiGlow ritual.
comparatif.description: Without dismissing either, two different approaches. Each has its place in a life, each has its constraints. Read each line aloud: every one stands on its own.

section.title: The questions we are asked.
section.description: The answers are short, precise, verifiable. If a question is missing, write to us: we will add it.

items.question: How long does a pack last?
items.answer: In daily use, the pack lasts four to five months. The paste runs out first, the powder follows. The buffer lasts about a year. Refills will be available from autumn 2026.

items.question: How often should I apply it?
items.answer: Every evening if you can, in five minutes. If you skip a day, that is fine: the maison welcomes the pause just as it welcomes the return.

items.question: Can I keep wearing polish?
items.answer: The ritual accommodates polish, even though it is designed to do without. Apply the paste and the powder on the evenings without polish. The plate breathes, the ritual settles into its slowness.

items.question: Is the ritual suitable during pregnancy?
items.answer: All formulas are free of volatile solvents, phthalates and toluene. We recommend speaking with your doctor: care is built in confidence.

items.question: What are the shipping times?
items.answer: Rabat: 24 h. Rest of Morocco: 48 to 72 h. Free shipping. International: we study each destination, shipping is by DHL with tracking.

items.question: Can I return the pack?
items.answer: Yes, within thirty days, even opened. Send us two lines at info@femiglow-maroc.com and we will collect the pack. Refund within five working days.

items.question: What if I am allergic to an ingredient?
items.answer: Each formula lists its full INCI on this page and on the jar label. If in doubt, we send you a sample before shipping the full pack.

items.question: Is the ritual suitable for teenagers?
items.answer: Yes, from the age of fourteen. The formulas are gentle, the gestures simple. It is often a first encounter with slow care.

origine.titre: An attention born of a simple observation.
origine.paragraph_1: FemiGlow was born of a simple observation: nails hold when given the time they ask for. No more, no less. Five minutes in the evening, two measured gestures and a buffer.
origine.paragraph_2: The idea took shape in Rabat, in an atelier on avenue Patrice Lumumba where the light falls just before 6 PM. Three crafts sat around a table: formulation, materials, writing. One conviction — slow beauty is an attention, never a performance.
origine.paragraph_3: Our founder is a biologist. She trained in cosmetic manufacturing before editing her first natural skincare lines. Today, she runs workshops in the same atelier where FemiGlow is designed. The ritual is not a discovery — it is a transmission.

fondatrice.paragraph_1: Our founder holds a master's degree in biology. She trained in cosmetic product manufacturing across several specialised courses. Before FemiGlow, she edited several natural skincare lines — each one taught her something about the gesture, the material, the traceability.
fondatrice.paragraph_2: She now runs workshops in the Rabat atelier, open to young Moroccan formulators. FemiGlow is her slowest maison.

atelier.description_1: The atelier fits in two quiet rooms: a clear worktop, a library of technical books and notebooks, material samples arranged by season.
atelier.description_2: We formulate here in small batches. Our founder receives by appointment, on Tuesdays and Thursdays, for workshops and consultations.

items.origine: Cold-pressed in Souss-Massa, Moroccan supply chain.
items.pourquoi: Liquid wax that mimics the skin's sebum — nourishes without leaving a film.

items.origine: Moroccan mining clay, quarry in Marrakech.
items.pourquoi: Polishes the nail without drying it — this is what brings the Step 4 buffer to life.

items.origine: Organic crops from Asia, traced supply chain.
items.pourquoi: A gentle absorbent — this is what gives the powder its matte finish, just before the shine.

section.title: Six lines that do not move.

origine.titre: An attention from Japan, passed on in Rabat.
origine.paragraph_1: In Japan, the care of the hand is not a product: it is a daily attention, slow, without declaration. The Japanese manicure — also known as kawaii or chigiri — dates back to the early 20th century. It reveals the natural shine of the nail through buffing, without polish.
origine.paragraph_2: Our founder brought this gesture back from a training trip. She set it within a Moroccan framework: local materials, halal certification, atelier at 25 bis avenue Patrice Lumumba, in Rabat.
origine.paragraph_3: The result fits in five minutes a day. No promises, no cure. A habit that settles in, as one sets a cup on a wooden table.

sciences.title: Three materials, three uses.

cire.paragraphe: Films the nail plate without sealing it. A 12-week clinical study observed a reduction in dorsal microfissures in subjects exposed to dry cold¹.

kaolin.paragraphe: A soft white clay. When the nail is smoothed, the Step 4 buffer does not score — it reveals the natural shine of the keratin².

halal.paragraphe: Material traceability, no denatured alcohol, no non-compliant animal derivatives. The label follows an audit by the Halal Cosmetics Council³.

sciences.source_1: Tanaka H. (2021). Beeswax-based barrier creams in cold-induced nail fragility. Journal of Cosmetic Dermatology 20(4).
sciences.source_2: Benyahia L. (2019). Kaolin clay polishing in non-invasive nail care. Annales de Dermatologie et de Vénéréologie 146(8).
sciences.source_3: Halal Cosmetics Council (2023). Standards for halal cosmetic ingredient sourcing and certification — public framework.

interview.introduction: our founder set her atelier at 25 bis avenue Patrice Lumumba, in Rabat. She formulates there, and she teaches there — other natural cosmetics lines pass through her hands. We asked her how the ritual is taught.

questions.question: You are a biologist by training. Why choose the gesture over the laboratory?
questions.reponse: The laboratory taught me INCI. The gesture taught me patience. The two complete each other — and that is what I pass on in my workshops in Rabat.

questions.question: Why the Japanese manicure?
questions.reponse: Because it does not cheat. It reveals rather than covers. Polish colours — the ritual polishes.

questions.question: What does halal change in a formulation?
questions.reponse: Everything. Origin of the materials, traceability, no denatured alcohol, no animal gelatin. It is not a marketing argument — it is a manufacturing framework.

questions.question: Five minutes a day is little. Why not more?
questions.reponse: Because the nail grows 0.1 mm a day. Five minutes is enough to keep pace. More would be useless. Less would be unfaithful.

questions.question: What would you advise an initiate who is starting?
questions.reponse: Begin with the paste. For a week, nothing else. You will see what your nails are telling you. The buffer comes next.

items.question: How long does the ritual take?
items.answer: Five minutes each evening, hands at rest. Two gestures — paste, powder — then the Step 4 buffer to finish. The maison suggests one passage a day to settle the cadence.

items.question: My nails are fragile, is the ritual right for me?
items.answer: Yes. The materials are chosen to repair without aggressing: beeswax, jojoba, cosmetic talc, rice powder, polishing kaolin. No acetone, no hardener. Avoid only in case of a known allergy to one of the ingredients; the full list appears on the Pack page.

items.question: What are the shipping times?
items.answer: Rabat: 24 hours. Casablanca and Salé: 24 to 48 hours. Rest of Morocco: 48 to 72 hours. Free shipping in Morocco, no threshold. For international, write to us, we study each shipment by hand.

items.question: How can I attend a workshop with your team?
items.answer: Our founder runs workshops in Japanese manicure and cosmetic manufacturing at the Rabat atelier. Write to info@femiglow-maroc.com with your profile (beauty professional, formulator, school). We reply within three days.
